name: Neon Spirals
description: Nested red spiral corridors sit inside broken outer hazard bands and split central spines. Four pink ring bouncers begin at the upper-left, lower-center and paired right-inner positions. Two cyan patrols start opposite one another on the lower side rails. Red terrain is lethal until captured; there are no cyan walls or interior safe islands. Start at bottom center, route around the red bands, and reconnect to the perimeter to reveal 75%.
